title: FloodConnect M8 sandwich trace
description: The decision-trail portion of floodconnect_model.sandwich_decision()'s return + kb.py's own `mid` wrapper -- exactly the keys `steps`, `reasons` (kb.py's answer key is `why`, the capped/trimmed view of `reasons` -- both are accepted here under `reasons` since `why` is a strict subset), `needs_middle`, and `mid` (kb.py's own key, `{read, rows}`, A5 fix: `mid.rows` is exactly what was passed to sandwich_decision on a real CONFLICT, never a re-filtered view).

reasons.description: sandwich_decision's own free-text reason codes (e.g. TOP_NO_UPSTREAM, TOP_UNREAD, WATER_COMING_ON_KG_PATH, MIDDLE_NOT_RISING, MIDDLE_UNOBSERVED, OUTLET_CRITICAL, BOTTOM_<colour>_NEVER_DOWNGRADED) -- an open vocabulary, not a closed enum, since sandwich_decision composes several of these per call.

needs_middle.description: True only on the legacy two-call contract (middle=None passed in) -- kb.py's own caller always passes middle already (P-A), so this is false on every real kb.py answer; kept for a direct floodconnect_model.sandwich_decision caller that still wants the two-call shape.

read.description: True iff the full capped toward-us middle read ran (A5: on a real CONFLICT only).

rows.description: Exactly the rows passed to sandwich_decision as `middle` on this call (A5) -- empty when `read` is false.
